title: KoMultiText: Large-Scale Korean Text Dataset for Classifying Biased Speech in Real-World Online Services
measurement_description: The paper evaluated the detection of biased speech related to religion. This was included as a sub-category within a broader 'Other Biases' label, which also encompassed biases related to occupation, animals, and specific communities.
findings: The models' performance in detecting religious bias was evaluated as part of a broader 'Others' bias category. This category proved challenging for the models, achieving the lowest performance scores (e.g., lowest AUROC and PRROC) compared to other, more specific bias types like gender or politics. The paper suggests this is due to the diversity of topics within the 'Others' category and insufficient training data for its subcategories, including religion.
